answer: Work-history escrow with a cliff: rewards accrue in escrow and release only after 7 epochs of independent activity, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. The ember cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the ledger, so a farm that abandons a set of aliases loses everything it put in, while the prism of forfeited funds pays honest graders and the yarrow curve is steepest at the start.
